title_block.title: Recipe Card Training Record: Revisions, Units and Pilot Lot Handoff
title_block.subtitle: Training completion record, signed

blocks.p: This record covers local staff training on recipe-card revisions, unit conventions and pilot-lot handoff documentation. Module coverage is listed in section 3; individual attendance and sign-off entries are retained with the training files.
Training uses the recipe cards and associated bench sheets so revision identity, preparation basis and handoff requirements can be read together.

list: A new recipe card revision needs reviewer sign-off before it is issued to the bench.
The superseded card is moved to the archive, not deleted, and the bench sheets that cite it keep their reference.
A card revision that changes a dose or loading assumption is also raised with the formulation development lead.

blocks.p: Concentrations are written in mg/mL. Loadings are written in weight percent, with the basis stated. Particle sizes are written in µm with the measurement method. Every value carries its unit beside it. A bare number on a card or a sheet is returned to the author, however small the change.

Conversion between weight percent and mg/mL requires the stated mass and volume basis, including density where relevant. These units are not interchangeable; the unit label alone is insufficient for conversion.
The handoff checklist lists the items that must travel with a pilot lot. Each item has a named owner, and an item is not closed until the owner has initialed it on the handoff sheet.

list: Recipe card number, revision letter and issue date.
Concentrations in mg/mL for each stock and the final formulation.
Loading in weight percent for each component, with the basis stated.
Dose assumption, its basis and its source.
Particle size in µm, the method used and the date measured.
Storage location of the retained material, as recorded by Sample Management.
Each open manufacturability risk, its owner and the date it must close.

blocks.p: The table lists module coverage for local staff. Signed source training entries record individual completion dates and assessor sign-offs.
This table records the listed module coverage only. Completion of one module does not imply completion of the others; additional coverage must be traced to individual training entries.
Completion sign-offs are retained with individual training entries. This summary does not assign examination scores, first-attempt passes or repeat attempts.
At handoff, each open manufacturability risk needs a named owner and disposition before the scale gate. Training completion does not replace that review.

This record is filed with the Quality training files. Signed copies are held by the CMC group. Training records for staff who later leave the group stay in the archive with the staff directory entry for that person, and their personal working folders are retained as archive material.
